title: C10 Supplement, cancel, change of subject, resend, reconnect and recovery
capability: While a history answer is being looked up or generated, the person may add to the question, cancel, move to another subject, re-send, lose the connection and come back. A supplement is folded into the answer; an abandoned answer never arrives late; nothing is stored twice; and a single-segment reply that was cut off never becomes a successful Assistant Event.

allowed.statement: Two people joined the paddling weekend: a friend and that friend's brother, who capsized almost immediately.
The renewal decision, not the outing, is what weighs on the person right now.

forbidden.statement: Retelling the windy second night and early return when only the companions were asked for.
Carrying on with the abandoned outing answer after the person moved on to the tenancy.
Describing the interruption in system terms such as retries, streams or lookups.

expectedBehavior: After the first cancel, answer the narrowed question about companions only.
After the second cancel and the change of subject, stay with the tenancy worry.
A re-sent message, before or after a restart, resolves to the original and generates nothing new.
Cancelled replies leave no committed Assistant Event.
failureSignals: An assistant reply appears in history for a cancelled turn.
A re-sent message is stored or answered twice.
The narrowed question is ignored and the whole outing is retold.
The reply to the change of subject goes back to the outing.

criteria.description: The first cancelled reply is never committed.
The narrowed question commits normally after the cancel.
The original account of the outing reaches the Provider for the narrowed question.
The second cancelled reply is never committed.
The change of subject commits and history matches the stream.
Re-sending the same message creates no second message and no second generation.
Re-sending after an app restart still resolves to the original message.
The conversation continues normally after the restart.
The narrowed question is answered as narrowed.
After the change of subject the reply stays with the tenancy and adds no stale continuation.
